name: wizard-shell
title: Wizard shell
description: The frame for a multi-step task: a top bar with save and exit, a step rail, the step content and a sticky footer with Back and Continue.
docs: Pass steps ({ title, description }), the current index and onContinue; you decide what comes next in your own state. titleAs makes the step heading an h1 (the default, because the step is the page) or an h2. The step's heading takes focus whenever current changes (never on first render), so the new step is announced; finished steps in the rail call onStepChange. Set canContinue to false with canContinueReason and the footer shows that sentence instead of a dead button; on a phone it gets a row of its own above the buttons. onContinue may return a promise: the button shows a spinner until it settles, and errors are yours to handle inside it. onSkip adds Skip for now, onExit adds Save and exit, help is a slot in the header. The last step's button says Finish unless you set continueLabel. The step fades in when it changes (not under reduced motion).
